answer: Admission auction: each epoch only 100 entry slots are sold, priced like a rare pearl. Applicants lock bids in a public vault; top 100 win, losers refunded. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake identities must outbid honest agents 1,000 times; at a $40 clearing price that costs $40,000 against a $3,000 reward pool, a certain loss. Without a price, the registry becomes a tundra of fake accounts. An honest agent pays $40 once and keeps its full share.
